translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: 1 Tesalonisiyen
book.title: 1 Tesalonisiyen Maktumne ta awalle taat Pool siirtu ɗo gee ku Tesalonik

content: ho iŋ Timote kat siiraat maktumne-an ɗo *Egliz kaak goy ɗo geeger ka Tesalonik, ɗo kuŋ kuuk geen̰ji ku Tatte Buŋ ho *Rabbinte Iisa Masi. Buŋ yaako barkiyiŋko ho yaako iye aapiye.
Ɗo bi kaŋko okiŋko, ni ozilaag Buŋ doo ho ni rawitgikonno ɗo salaaner.
Ɗo uŋji ka Tatte Buŋ, ni pakirgiy doo ɗo imaanko iŋ eliŋko kaak n̰aamaako ku giniy riy dakina ho ere kaak ku eriy *Rabbin Iisa Masi iŋ gelbin rakki.
Gem kol siŋtay, ni iban kadar Buŋ elgiiko ho ŋa doɓiŋko kuu gine geen̰ji.

Ka seener, wiktin taat ni iyiikon Kabarre ta Gala-an, taar arro kaaw ta maalan di, asaan Ruwwin ta Buŋdi gaayiini, ni ibintu tam kadar kaawni ka seener. Ampa-ak Kabarre-at asko iŋ gudurre. Kuŋ maaniiko iban maman ni goyiy iŋ kuŋko ho ku talinti ni obiiko wero.
Kar kuŋ gay iciig goyinni ho iŋ ka Rabbin Iisa Masi, asaan iŋ taaɓin taat gee taaɓiyiiko-an oki, ku obit samaane kaaw ta Buŋdi iŋ galal. Galal-an taar asa min Ruwwin ta Buŋdi.
Paa kat, ku gaariy iŋ goyiŋko ɗo gee ku Buŋdi okin̰co kuuk ɗo kiɗ ka Maseduwaan iŋ ka Akayi, maman ŋuur oki yaa goye.

Ampaa ko, ɗo werko, kaaw ta Rabbin bal peye ɗo kiɗ ka Maseduwaan iŋ ka Akayi di. Kar gay, gee kuuk goy ɗo wer okin̰ji gas kabarre kadar ku aamin ɗo Buŋdi. Ampa-ak, ya ni kaawaaɗo pey biti sa ginaaɗo maanna
asaan ŋuur maaniico osa maman ku obinti ɗo werko, maman ku rasiig marginko ho ku newsitu abdiye Buŋ kaak goy mento ho taɓ.
Ho ŋu osa pey maman kuu ƴoke Roŋji Iisa. Buŋ nooyiig Iisa min ɗo muuti, ŋa cooniig kuwa ho ŋaa yeepe ŋaate jilinte min dapin̰ko ta Buŋdi taat yaa paaye ɗo kaaco ka gee kuuk bal aamine loci.

footnotes.text: ‛Silben’ : Ŋa ŋaar ko ŋu koliy oki Silaas.
